compare.br: No Brasil, as famílias compram material escolar em janeiro e fevereiro, e muitas escolas mandam uma lista.
compare.us: Nos EUA, a compra acontece em agosto e as lojas fazem promoções de “back to school”.

pages.title: A blue backpack · 1/3
paragraphs: It is the last week of summer in Miami. Zoe has a new school year ahead. She needs notebooks, pencils and a bag. She walks into a bright store near her home. The shelves are full of colorful things. A clerk named Nina comes to help her.
“Welcome! Are you looking for something?” says Nina. “Yes. I need supplies for school.” says Zoe. “We have notebooks, pencils and backpacks.” says Nina.

pages.title: A blue backpack · 3/3
paragraphs: “Great. Can I pay by card?” says Zoe. “Of course. Here is your receipt.” says Nina. Nina puts the notebooks and pencils in a bag. Zoe tries the blue backpack on her shoulders. She pays by card and takes the receipt. At home, she writes her name on every notebook. She puts everything in the new backpack. A new year starts with a new bag.
